summary: Iteration 5: Comprehensive testing of 3 new features - Dashboard Activity Timeline, Sidebar Color Enhancement, and Reports Page 5-Tab Overhaul. All 15 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend UI flows work correctly with all features visible and functional.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts library warning during initial render, not affecting functionality

passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (15/15 passed) ===
GET /api/dashboard/activity-feed - returns activity items
GET /api/dashboard/activity-feed?limit=5 - respects limit parameter
Activity feed items have required fields (id, type, title, timestamp)
Activity feed includes call log entries (MOCKED)
GET /api/reports/technician-utilization - returns tech data
Tech data has required fields (id, name, total_hours, billable_hours, utilization, tickets_assigned, tickets_resolved, revenue)
GET /api/reports/ticket-analytics - returns analytics object
Ticket analytics has required fields (total, by_status, by_priority, by_client, by_category, avg_resolution_hours, sla_compliance)
GET /api/reports/client-analytics - returns client list
Client data has required fields (id, name, mrr, total_tickets, open_tickets, total_devices, online_devices, billable_revenue)
GET /api/reports/revenue - returns revenue data
Revenue data has required fields (total_mrr, annual_run_rate, outstanding, billable_revenue, mrr_by_client, invoices_by_status)
GET /api/reports/device-analytics - returns device data
Device data has required fields (total, by_type, by_status, by_client, total_alerts, active_alerts)
GET /api/dashboard/stats - still works (backward compatibility)
=== Frontend UI Tests (all passed) ===
UI: Dashboard loads with all 4 stat cards (Total Clients, Online Devices, Open Tickets, Monthly Revenue)

UI: Sidebar nav items use lighter text color (text-slate-200) for better readability
UI: Reports page loads at /reports

UI: Reports date range selector visible and works
UI: Date range options: Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, This Year
UI: Technicians tab shows 4 KPI cards (Total Techs, Total Billable Hours, Avg Utilization, Total Revenue)

UI: Technicians tab shows Technician Details table with Name, Hours, Utilization, Tickets, Revenue columns
